newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends lower but support intact.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends lower but support intact.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures ended weaker but off the lows in thin dealings, which left many trading sources wondering just where the market is headed.
"We went out sort of mixed. The close above 11.00 cents is constructive, but we didn't trade up on the day, which is negative," Tony Passimenti, a Merrill Lynch broker, said. "Today was a wash."

The benchmark July contract settled down 0.06 cent per lb at 11.05 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.11 to 10.98 cents. Second-position October fell 0.05 to 10.85 cents, while the remaining months finished 0.04 and 0.05 lower.
An estimated 11,992 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Tuesday's official 18,085 lots.

Floor sources said the locals came in long but became sellers on a lack of follow-through in early trade. Trade buying over 11.00 cents prevented July from falling below 10.95, where sell stops are expected to be resting.

Trading sources pegged the downside target at 10.85 cents. To the upside, heavy producer selling is expected to limit gains at 11.20. Nearby resistance was pegged at the day's high of 11.11 cents in July.
